decisions.evidence: Taken together, despite the relatively high TPSA of 104.81, the combination of large Labute surface area 228.3483, alkyl aryl ether count 4, rotatable-bond count 14, nitro (1), tertiary amide (1), low neutral fraction 0.0158, and no acidic site makes the molecule more likely to block hERG.
Overall, the balance of evidence supports option (B): blocks hERG.
